Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept. Asset type: architectural surface art direction for the existing Prism Route game. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and also the exact composition, existing building-massing, curvature, environment and game art style reference. Produce ONE landscape 16:9 conceptual paintover of this same view. Preserve the camera, waterline, curved white megastructure massing on left, large arched opening, planted terraces, background cable bridge, blue sky, clear turquoise water, stylized green trees and the overall calm bright palette. The main subject is the huge foreground CURVED wall surface, which must visibly receive the proposed parametric architectural treatment. Improve readability of shallow shadows on white material without making the scene dark. Surface design must wrap and follow the actual curved host surface, horizontal paths flow continuously around bends with coherent perspective. This is a near-future abandoned utopian infrastructure, simple buildable large architectural components, restrained and tranquil. Favor large unbroken pale surfaces, meaningful joints, restrained warm-gray recessed shadow, a few selective omissions/breaks suggesting old construction. Any vegetation must be sparse, small, simplified flat-painted leaf-only clusters attached to an actual recess or top edge, no stems, no photographic foliage, no floating green decals in the middle of blank surfaces. Avoid square tiles, checkerboard, brickwork, allover rectangular panel grids, greeble noise, rusty machinery, cyberpunk neon, dystopian brown grime, ancient temple motifs, statues, added people, text blocks. This is an AI art-direction paintover, not an actual implemented game screenshot.
Design A — HORIZONTAL STRATA. Treat the foreground curved facade as 4 to 6 very long, broad, gently projecting horizontal shell bands at VARIABLE heights, each several metres tall, with very thin recessed shadow gaps between them. Some bands taper in projection, merge into the intact wall and disappear before the arch; never an equal-height tiled wall. Almost no vertical cuts: only 2 or 3 widely separated long staggered construction terminations, with soft chamfered edges. Show curvature by the bands smoothly wrapping around it. One short missing edge section reveals a deeper darker layer and a tiny flat-green leaf cluster. Keep at least 65 percent broad clean white material. The subtle changes in band depth and sparse eroded interruptions convey near-future ruins. Place only a small clean label 'A / HORIZONTAL STRATA' in upper left.
